# theprototype.app

> Collaborative peer-to-peer 3D prototyping in the browser. No accounts and no
> server beyond PeerJS signaling — a session is a direct WebRTC peer mesh, so
> everything one person does is visible to everyone connected. Desktop and VR
> (WebXR), a node/flow editor that drives scene behavior, and a module SDK for
> loadable, self-contained play content. Built with SvelteKit (static adapter),
> Svelte 5, Threlte and three.js.

## Modules (write your own)

- [Module SDK guide, inlined](/llms-full.txt): the full guide — the api surface,
  the one rule that matters (a module runs on every peer), layout/registration,
  and worked examples. Fetch this to write a correct module without guessing the
  API.

## Key concepts

- Everything replicates over the peer mesh: apply the change locally, then
  broadcast it; a receiver applies it WITHOUT re-broadcasting.
- Two sync models — deterministic (a pure function of a seed/params plus a
  shared synced clock) vs authoritative (one initiator simulates and
  broadcasts). Pick one per feature; never mix them.
- A module is a self-contained default export
  `{ id, name, version, description, register(api) }` in
  `src/modules/<id>/module.js`; user modules (zip/URL) must have no imports.
- Script and flow nodes are pure functions of `(object, base, data, time)`
  evaluated identically on every peer — never stream their outputs.
- Randomness must be seeded: send the seed, not the result, or peers desync.

## Docs

- [llms-full.txt](/llms-full.txt): this map plus the entire module SDK guide
  inline (works offline / without repo access).
